title: Little Lampkeepers: Shine Your Light This Fall
subtitle: A Christian Fall Activity Book for Kids Ages 5–8
tagline: Bible coloring, Search & Find, mazes, gratitude, and harvest fun
author_line: A Little Lampkeepers Faith Activity Book
ownership: Created for families who want Bible-first fall fun. Scripture quotations are from the 1769 Oxford King James Version, public domain in the United States.
welcome_body: This book is a set of eight Fall Faith Missions.
In every mission you will color a story picture, search for hidden gifts, walk a maze, and choose a way to live the verse.
There is no race. Take your time. Ask a grown-up to read the Bible words with you.
When you finish a page, you can color more, pray the short prayer, or tell someone one kind thing you can do.
how_to_use: Color the big picture. Stay in the open shapes with crayon or colored pencil.
Search & Find: look for all 8 gifts, then circle each one.
Maze: start at START and find the one path to FINISH. Do not cross the thick lines.
Faith in Action: check the boxes that fit you, then draw in the big empty space.
Answer keys are in the back if you need a hint.
parent_title: A Note for Parents and Caregivers
parent_body: Little Lampkeepers is Bible-first, not merely Bible-themed. Each mission is locked to one public-domain King James verse. A short child paraphrase sits beside the reference so a 5-to-8-year-old can understand the idea without treating activity props as Scripture.
Lanterns, pumpkins, barns, and fall festivals are story clothes for the lesson. They are not claims from the verse. Please keep that distinction when you talk with your child.
Work beside your child when you can. Read the verse aloud. Let them choose colors. Celebrate effort more than finished polish.
Bible source note: quotations are from the 1769 Oxford King James Version, which is public domain in the United States. Child paraphrases are original and are never mixed into the source text.
map_intro: Follow Mira and Eli through eight missions. Each stop has coloring, Search & Find, a maze, and a faith page.
certificate_body: has completed all eight Fall Faith Missions and practiced shining God's light.
closing_body: The book is finished, but the mission is not. Take your lantern of kindness into the kitchen, the classroom, the sidewalk, and the supper table. God is with you.
gratitude_intro: Draw or write three thanks with a grown-up. They can be small: a crunchy leaf, a warm drink, a person who helped you.
prayer_walk_intro: Walk outside with a grown-up. Notice one thing you see, one thing you hear, and one person to pray for. Then pray a short thank-you.
cover_back: Join Mira and Eli for eight Bible missions this fall: coloring pages, Search & Find scenes, mazes, and faith-in-action drawing. Ages 5–8. Black-and-white interior made for crayons, with a warm Christian harvest story in every chapter.
